framing.lineOfInquiry: Sachin Chopra (P00232) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE032
framing.alternate: Sachin Chopra (P00232) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sachin Chopra was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as witness, not as accused
FIR text contains: '…no role has been attributed…'

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sachin Chopra's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Manpreet Khanna since 2025-04-17, 26 days before the incident (18 calls, 11 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Varun Bansal since 2025-04-20, 23 days before the incident (13 calls, 11 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Sachin Chopra was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 8 other days (25 Apr – 12 Jun), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Someone else used the phone or handset

comparison.verdict: Every supporting item could be explained by at least one alternate, although the line of inquiry is stronger on weight (0.48 vs 0.34). Test the alternates before relying on it.
settleWith: A6 — Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

note: Each hypothesis is tested from both sides to reduce confirmation bias. Confidence scores are evidential balance (not probability of guilt). Human review is required.
